description: Installation of a sliding vehicle gate within the existing boundary wall to provide access from Maier Avenue to off street parking within the garden, including the formation of a small permeable parking area. The gate will operate by sliding laterally within the property boundary and will not open onto the estate road.
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed gate, due to its use as a vehicular access, its location, the associated constraints of the rear curtilage of the site and vehicular right-of-way, and the absence of sufficient information including a swept path analysis to indicate safe and acceptable ingress and egress from the site or assessment of visibility between the hard standing and the vehicular right-of-way due to the extant rear boundary wall, would be likely to cause on-street parking problems and prejudice highway safety, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policy T4F of The London Plan (2021) and Policy M2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposed gate,&nbsp; by reason of its scale, design and&nbsp; its lack of harmony with the existing street scene, would result in an unsympathetic addition which would result in a loss of uniformity to the pattern of development in the street, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the area, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (1) and (11) of the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposed hard standing and associated parking space, due to the significant percentage of the rear curtilage proposed to be occupied and the resulting deprivation of the quantum and quality of amenity space for the residents of the property, would be detrimental to the residential amenities of the existing and future occupiers, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (7) of the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
